## GMI Crypto Media (How to make it in Crypto Media) - Top up proposal V2

**Date: 16/02/2022**

## [Network Services](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/3650-decent-partners-an-introduction-to-network-services)
Decent Partners
## 
## **Proposal summary**

This proposal covers the [original proposal](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/1135-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-an-original-podcast-series), [the failed top up proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/3255-gmi-crypto-media-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-top-up-proposal) and a new funding request that takes into account the communities feedback and is now presented by [Decent Partners](https://decent.partners) in the role of a network services provider.

## Introduction

GMI In Crypto Media is a public service podcast series featuring some of the best names in crypto-media, is hosted by[@Joon Ian Wong](/edgeware/account/nW2iu3Y2ZECd9dsD8mJksAwKjF482grXUC972Zi1aoxTgph) one of the most well known journalists in the space and delivered by award winning podcast producer[ @Pet Berisha](/edgeware/account/iD3QwESnDJC5nSNPYH7ZXAviQ3yvPapfVMufUef3BM4aTmf).  

So far the team have interviewed:

- **Raoul Pal: CEO Realvision**
- **David Bailey: Bitcoin Magazine**
- **Dave Nemetz: Founder Bleacher Report and diving into web3 **
- **Camila Russo: Founder Defiant**
- **Marc Hochstein: Exec Editor Coindesk**
- **Alanna Roazzi- Laforet: Decrypt**
